nodes.title: Congruence maps between levels
nodes.statement: (§8.2, Lemma 8.2 and (8.1).) For deformation data 𝒟_c = 𝒟_0 ≤ 𝒟_1 ≤ ⋯ ≤ 𝒟_n = 𝒟 (strict steps adding one place w_i, either to Σ or removing it from ℳ) and 𝔭 nice: R_i = (R̃^min_{𝒟_i})_{𝔭̃}, T_i, M_i and M⁺_i are free over Λ̃_{𝒪,P} with M_i^{2^s} ≅ Hom(M⁺_i, Λ̃_{𝒪,P})^{2^s} (Lemma 8.2); and there are T_i-maps Φ_i : M_{i−1}^{2^s r_i} → M_i^{2^s}, Φ̂_i, Ψ_i, Θ_i (r_i = 2 or 3) with Φ_i injective with Λ̃-free cokernel, Φ̂_i surjective, Θ_i∘Φ̂_i∘Φ_i∘Ψ_i = (unit·η_i *; 0 A_i) with det A_i not a zero divisor in T_0, and η_i = (q_i − 1)(T(ℓ_i)² − S(ℓ_i)(q_i + 1)²), (q_i − 1)(q_i + 1) or (q_i − 1) according as w_i ∈ Σ_i ∖ Σ_{i−1}, w_i ∈ ℳ_{i−1} with χ|_{I_{w_i}} = 1, or with χ|_{I_{w_i}} ≠ 1 (q_i = Nm(ℓ_i)).
hypotheses: 𝔭 nice for 𝒟.
proofSteps: Lemma 8.2 from Lemma 3.29 at auxiliary primes r_1, …, r_s and Proposition 3.3 with (3.17).
Φ_i = 2^s copies of f ↦ f + α_i g (+ α_i² h), with kernels and cokernels killed by T(ℓ) − 1 − Nm(ℓ) (Lemmas 3.26–3.28), hence trivial after localising at the non-Eisenstein 𝔭 (8.1a).
Explicit Ψ_i, Θ_i and the 3×3 matrix give the determinant (q_iS(ℓ_i)^{−2})^{2^s}η_i^{2^s−1} (8.1b).
acceptance: η_i is the level-raising congruence factor at w_i.

nodes.title: R = T at nice primes (all levels)
nodes.statement: (Proposition 8.1.) If 𝔭 ⊆ T_𝒟 is nice for 𝒟 (F of even degree), then ψ(𝒟, 𝔭) : (R̃^min_𝒟)_{𝔭̃} → (T̃^min_𝒟)_{𝔭̃} is an isomorphism.
hypotheses: F of even degree; 𝔭 nice for 𝒟.
proofSteps: For 𝒟 = 𝒟_c this is Proposition 7.3 (printed 'Proposition 7.2' on p. 119: E8). In general, compose the chain 𝒟_c ≤ ⋯ ≤ 𝒟 of §8.2; Lemma 8.4 cuts by a regular sequence y_1, …, y_{m−1} to a DVR C (8.3).
T′_0 is a reduced complete intersection over C, so ℓ_C(H_0/H_0²) = ℓ_C(C/δ(G_0)) (8.4) by de Smit–Rubin–Schoof Criterion I (R03.3).

The congruence maps give ℓ_C(C/(δ∘α)(G_n)) ≥ ℓ_C(C/δ(G_0)) + ℓ_C(C/δ(η)) (8.5); deformation theory gives ℓ_C(H_n/H_n²) ≤ ℓ_C(H_0/H_0²) + ℓ_C(C/δ(η)) (8.7), via Hom_C(R′_n, C ⊕ εC/λ^m) ↪ H¹(F_Σ/F, ad ρ/λ^m) (8.8) and the local count (8.10).
Hence ℓ_C(H_n/H_n²) ≤ ℓ_C(C/(δ∘α)(G_n)); DRS Criterion I makes R′_n → T″_n an isomorphism of complete intersections, and faithful flatness over B gives ψ(𝒟, 𝔭).
acceptance: This is the 'R = T' of the paper: it holds only after localisation and completion at a nice prime, and it uses the numerical (Wiles–Lenstra–de Smit–Rubin–Schoof) criterion, not an explicit presentation.

requests.need: Definite quaternionic forms over a totally real F of even degree, for D ramified exactly at the infinite places: X(U) = D^×\G^D(A_f)/U finite; H⁰(X(U), R) = H⁰(X(U), ℤ) ⊗ R free of rank #X(U); the Hecke operators [UgU′] (T(ℓ), S(ℓ), T₀(p_v), T₀(p) and the action of G(U_a)) commuting and preserving integrality; the norm-factoring subspace I^D(U); pullback and trace between levels; stabiliser orders c_U(x) with c_{U_a}(x) = 1 for a large; free action after an auxiliary level (Skinner–Wiles Lemma 3.5 and Corollary 3.6); and finite-level freeness over 𝒪/πⁿ[Δ_w] for a fixed-point-free action. Also: Eichler's norm theorem for D (every totally positive element of F is a reduced norm) and strong approximation for the norm-one group G^D_1 at a place w where D splits (used in Skinner–Wiles Lemma 3.26).
requests.note: R18.3 owns the quaternionic sets, their Hecke action, change of level and Taylor–Wiles freeness; R21.1 only applies the ordinary projector and passes to the ordinary towers.

requests.need: The Jacquet–Langlands–Shimizu isomorphism S^D(U) = H⁰(X(U), ℂ)/I^D(U) ≅ S₂(U), compatible with all [UgU′], for the definite quaternion algebra over an even-degree totally real field unramified at all finite places.

Adelic Hilbert modular forms M_k(U), S_k(U) of weight k ∈ ℤ[I] with Fourier expansions and Shimura's integrality M_k(n, A) = M_k(n, ℤ) ⊗ A; the Hecke operators T(ℓ), S(ℓ), T₀(p_v); local newform theory (dim V_{π,v}^{U_v} = 1 at unramified v) and Hida's classification of unit T₀(p_v)-eigenlines ([H3, Corollary 2.2]).

Hida's totally real theory on the quaternionic ordinary towers of R21.1 (Skinner–Wiles §3.2): M_∞(U) and M⁺_∞(U) free over Λ′_𝒪 of rank rank_𝒪 eH⁰(X(U⁰_1), 𝒪) × #(G(U)_tors) under the fixed-point-free hypothesis (Proposition 3.3, Hida [H2, Theorem 3.8]); T_∞(U, 𝒪) finite torsion-free over Λ′_𝒪 and semilocal complete (Corollary 3.4); control in all weights (Proposition 3.7, Hida [H2, Corollary 2.5]); density of weight-two algebraic primes on each component (Lemma 3.8, Corollary 3.9); and Wiles' Λ-adic forms ([W2, Theorem 1.4.1]).
requests.note: RS-08: R21.2 imports the cuspidal totally real Hida control from PadicFamilies L5 and keeps only the additional nearly ordinary and Eisenstein statements.

requests.need: The Deligne–Ribet p-adic L-function L_p(F, s, χω) with its interpolation of L^{(p)}(F, 1 − n, χω^{1−n}); Hilbert Eisenstein series E_n(φ₁, φ₂) of parallel weight n, spanning a complement of the cusp forms, with constant terms a_i(E_n(1, ψ), 0) = 2^{−d}L(F, 1 − n, ψ)Nm(t_i)^{n/2} (Skinner–Wiles (3.10)); Chai's integral form g with a_i(g, 0) = 2^{−d}Nm(t_i)^{n/2} for large n ≡ 2 mod (p − 1)p^f ([Ch, §4.5], (3.11)); and Wiles' vanishing of Eisenstein combinations with zero constant terms ([W3, Proposition 1.6]). Also the congruences for the Deligne–Ribet p-adic L-function under abelian p-extensions (Skinner–Wiles (4.17), citing [Co], [D-R], [Se]).
Local–global compatibility away from p for the Galois representations of nearly ordinary Hilbert eigenforms: π_v ≅ π_v(ρ_π) for v ∤ p (Skinner–Wiles (3.3), [W2, Theorem 2.1.3]).

For ρ_0 = χ ⊕ 1 on D_i with χ|_{D_i} ≠ 1 and determinant χ̃: the versal local 𝒪-deformation ring R^{(i)} and the versal nearly ordinary ring R^{(i)}_ord (ρ ≅ (χ̃Ψ *; 0 Ψ^{−1}), Ψ ≡ 1), with Skinner–Wiles Lemma 2.2: R^{(i)}_ord ≅ 𝒪[[x_1, …, x_{2d_i+2}]]/(f) if χ|_{D_i} = ω or ω = 1, else 𝒪[[x_1, …, x_{2d_i+1}]] (tangent dimension from local duality); and Corollary 2.3: R^{(i)}_ord is a quotient of R^{(i)} by an ideal generated by d_i + ε_i elements, ε_i = 2 if χ|_{D_i} = ω = χ^{−1}|_{D_i}, 1 if exactly one of χ|_{D_i} = ω, ω = χ^{−1}|_{D_i}, ω = 1 holds in the stated combinations, 0 otherwise.
requests.note: RS-08 gives R21.3 the global deformation rings with L8's local ordinary rings; the residually split p-distinguished case is the one needed here.

requests.need: Mazur's unframed presentation for a Schur residual representation with fixed determinant: R ≅ 𝒪[[x_1, …, x_{g′}]]/(f_1, …, f_{r′}) with g′ = h¹(F_Σ/F, ad⁰ρ̄) and r′ ≤ h²(F_Σ/F, ad⁰ρ̄) ([M, Proposition 2]); R04.3's framed presentation assumes absolute irreducibility.
Tate's global Euler characteristic formula for H^i(F_Σ/F, ad⁰ρ̄) with F totally real and ρ̄ odd, giving h¹ − h² ≥ 2d for ad⁰ρ_c.
Schlessinger's criteria (H1)–(H4) for functors on complete local Noetherian 𝒪-algebras with finite residue field, applied to the functor of pseudo-deformations.

Wiles' Galois representations ρ_π for ordinary Hilbert eigenforms of parallel weight κ ≥ 2 (Skinner–Wiles (3.2), [W2]): ρ_π(z_1) = diag(1, −1), unramified outside 𝔫p, trace ρ_π(Frob_ℓ) = λ(T(ℓ)), det ρ_π(Frob_ℓ) = λ(S(ℓ))Nm(ℓ), det ρ_π(x) = λ(S_x)ε(x), and ρ_π|_{D_i} ≅ (ψ_1 *; 0 ψ_2) with ψ_2(y) = λ(T_y), ψ_2(λ_{𝔭_i}) = λ(T_0(𝔭_i)).

Base change and descent for Hilbert modular forms along solvable totally real extensions (Skinner–Wiles cite [GL]): given a newform f_1 over L with L/F solvable and ρ_{f_1} ≅ ρ|_{G_L} for an irreducible ρ of G_F, a newform f over F with ρ_f|_{G_L} ≅ ρ_{f_1}.

Abstract patching over A = k[[T]] (Skinner–Wiles §5): given rings, trace subrings and modules at levels (N, a) with the axioms (5.1)–(5.11), the level-(a, c) structures take finitely many isomorphism types, nested subsequences give inverse limits, and the patched R_∞ ⊗ K is a power series ring with M_∞ free; the argument works on deformation rings whose residue fields are not finite.
requests.note: RS-08: R21.4 imports abstract module patching from R03.5 and keeps the arithmetic verification (§7).

requests.need: Auslander–Buchsbaum; de Smit–Rubin–Schoof, Criteria for complete intersections (Compositio 1997), Lemma 4.1 and Criterion I (for a surjection R ↠ T of complete local C-algebras finite over a DVR C, with T a reduced complete intersection: R ≅ T iff ℓ_C(H_R/H_R²) ≤ ℓ_C(C/δ(G_T)), and then both are complete intersections).

Chebotarev selection of primes w with Nm(w) ≡ 1 mod p^m and prescribed Frobenius image in the splitting field of ρ mod λ^m together with a cohomology class, for ρ over a characteristic-p DVR A = k[[λ]] (Skinner–Wiles Proposition 6.10).
Wiles' Selmer-group formula #H_Σ(𝒯)/#H*_Σ(𝒯) = h_∞∏_w h_w for finite Galois modules over a totally real field ([W1, Proposition 1.6]; Poitou–Tate with the local Euler characteristic).

Selmer groups with local conditions L_w and their duals L*_w under local duality, and the tangent-space embedding Hom(R, C ⊕ εC/λ^m) ↪ H¹(F_Σ/F, ad ρ/λ^m) with local conditions (Skinner–Wiles (8.8)–(8.10)).

gaps.title: Raynaud's connectedness theorem (Skinner–Wiles Proposition A.1)
gaps.detail: If A is a local Cohen–Macaulay ring of dimension d and I is generated by r ≤ d − 2 elements, Spec(A/I) ∖ {m_A} is connected (Raynaud, Anneaux locaux henséliens, Corollaire 4.2; a form of Grothendieck's connectedness theorem, SGA 2 XIII). Skinner–Wiles cite it without proof. No roadmap stage in the atlas plans it and Mathlib does not have it; it should go to a commutative-algebra owner.

Math. 49 (1978); Skinner–Wiles cite [Wa]); Theorem A's (4.13). IntegralIwasawaTheory L2/L4 plan class-number growth and Ferrero–Washington (ℓ = p), not this theorem; no stage plans it.

sourceIssues.printed: The source argues that goodness of (F, 𝒟) makes L_p(F, −1, χω) a nonunit in 𝒪, and then uses Proposition 3.14 to deduce that T_∞(U^χ, 𝒪) possesses a permissible maximal ideal m.
sourceIssues.reason: Proposition 3.14 is the level-by-type statement; the existence of a permissible maximal ideal of T_∞(U^χ, 𝒪) from ord_π L_p(F, −1, χω) > 0 is Proposition 3.18.
